title: MAPLE: Metadata Conditioned LLM Pretraining for Locale-Aware Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2601.15236v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models can memorize competing locale-specific facts yet fail to select among them when the locale changes, defaulting instead to a single globally dominant answer. We formalize this as localized knowledge disambiguation and introduce LocalNewsQA, an 18,700-item English-news benchmark that pairs the same question across two locales and scores whether a model actually switches its answer when the locale changes. We also introduce MAPLE, a controlled family of decoder-only models pretrained with document-level geographic metadata (source URL, country, and continent) already present in the training corpus, and compare it to metadata-free controls trained on identical data with the same token budget, architecture, and optimization. translated_title: MAPLE：基于元数据条件化的大语言模型预训练用于地域感知问答
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型能够记住相互冲突的地域特定事实，但在地域变化时却无法在这些事实之间进行选择，反而默认给出一个全球占主导的单一答案。我们将此形式化为局部知识消歧，并引入了LocalNewsQA，这是一个包含18,700条英文新闻的基准测试，它将同一问题配对到两个地域，并评估模型在地域变化时是否真正切换其答案。我们还引入了MAPLE，这是一个受控的解码器专用模型系列，其预训练利用了训练语料中已有的文档级地理元数据（来源URL、国家和大陆），并将其与在相同数据、相同令牌预算、架构和优化条件下训练的无元数据对照组进行比较。在1B和3B规模的受控实验中，当推理时元数据固定时，使用MAPLE中的元数据进行预训练产生了可测量的切换效果，并提高了那些正确答案依赖于特定地域的问题的准确性。
tldr: 本文提出MAPLE方法，通过在预训练时加入地理元数据，使语言模型能够根据地域变化切换答案，解决局部知识消歧问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MAPLE, which incorporates geographic metadata during pretraining to enable language models to switch answers based on locale, addressing localized knowledge disambiguation.
